# Paths that pages outside this repository link to. GitHub does not redirect a moved or renamed
# path, so .github/scripts/check_repo_paths.py fails while a listed path is missing. To move one,
# update the pages that link it first: keep the old path (for example, as a copy) until they point
# to the new one. Then remove its line in the pull request that removes the old path.
